title: 第一卷 第5章 狐朋狗友第一卷 第6章 威胁
content_zh:
或许是面板上形成的技能的原因，李乘风感觉自己的胃像无底洞一样能吃。
一只肥竹鼠身上卸下来的足有八斤肉，除去刘玉娘吃的一斤多点，剩下的全让他自己一个人吃光了才觉得饱。
而吃完了这些，他身上也觉得暖暖洋洋的，舒服得直犯困。
“乘风，我好久没吃这么饱过，有过肉了。”
刘玉娘也吃得很饱，她把碗筷收拾好，又打水给李乘风和自己洗了洗脚后，上到床上，和李乘风躺在一起，抱着他的脖子，眼神里带着幸福地开口，但是说完眉宇里又涌现一些紧张，“但是咱们这吃饱饭不容易，是你冒着风险进山打猎得来的，答应我，你别再跟以前那些朋友一起去喝酒赌钱了好吗？”
本来有些犯困的李乘风听到刘玉娘这话愣了愣。
这才想起来原身这个小短工挣点钱不容易，不好好生活就罢了，居然一有点小钱，还有去喝酒赌钱的习惯。
穷成这样了还不好好过日子，反而还沾染上坏习惯，李乘风心中都无语了，这家伙也太废了吧。
但是想了想，穿越后这具身体名字和样貌都和自己穿越前一模一样，也许这只是另一个世界的自己而已，顿时心中有些尴尬。
“你放心吧，玉娘，我知道轻重，打猎不容易，就算是有钱，我也不会去喝酒了，更不会去赌钱了。”
李乘风抱着刘玉娘的肩膀安慰地开口。
他们家里只有一张床，所以每天晚上都和刘玉娘睡在一起，只不过从前刘玉娘都是和他分头睡，而今天，她却主动跑过来和他睡在了一头。
孤男寡女睡一个被窝，有些暧昧。
但是局势紧张，连饭都不能保证吃饱，李乘风心中有浓浓的危机感，再加上身上的疲惫感，心中实在是生不起来丝毫男女之事的想法。
男人其实是最需要安全感的，当有危机、紧张、有压力的时候，是没有办法在那方面起来能力的，也生不起状态。
所以李乘风只是抱着刘玉娘的肩膀与她安慰，并没有做些什么。
———至于身体养好、吃饱稳定、家里状态好之后…那李乘风可是要好好的让玉娘过过舒服的好日子。
“好，乘风，我信你。”
刘玉娘听到李乘风的话，嘴角抿起一抹笑意，旋即软绵绵地靠在李乘风的肩膀上，语气温柔地开口，“那我明天就不去做活了，家里那两个野鹅可以去卖了，到集市上换点粮食和盐，光吃肉没有粮食不行。”
“等以后你要是再打到更多猎物了，就换两匹布，买两个鞋底，我给你做衣裳，做鞋。”

“要是打不了太多猎物，那咱就先自己吃着。要是连自己吃的也不够，那我就再出去做活.............”
刘玉娘小声地盘算，脸上满是对未来生活的期待，布满着光彩。
她曾经也是妇人，但是从未过过眼前这样有希望的日子，此时期待着未来，眉宇间竟然涌现小女人的神色。
但吃饱后实在让人困倦，她本身也疲惫了，说着说着不知不觉就沉沉睡去。
李乘风感受着怀中女人的动情，心中也十分感慨，感慨之余亦有些沉重。
心中对那刘洪的杀心更重了。
‘不止刘洪，那郑老爷也是一个麻烦。’
李乘风心中念头翻涌，待刘玉娘睡去之后，也默默地闭目睡了。
“……”
content_en:
Perhaps because of the skills formed on the panel, Li Chengfeng felt like his stomach was as full of food as a bottomless pit.
A fat bamboo rat had eight kilograms of meat removed from its body. Except for Liu Yuniang, who ate just over a kilogram, he had to eat the rest by himself before he felt full.
After eating these, he felt warm and comfortable, making him sleepy.
"Chengfeng, I haven't been so full and full of meat in a long time."
Liu Yuniang was also very full. She put away the dishes and fetched water for Li Chengfeng and her own feet. After that, she got on the bed, lay down with Li Chengfeng, hugged his neck, and spoke with happiness in her eyes. But after she finished speaking, some nervousness appeared in her eyebrows, "But it's not easy for us to have enough food. You took the risk to go hunting in the mountains to get it. Promise me, you won't go drinking and gambling with those friends in the past, okay?"
Li Chengfeng, who was a little sleepy, was stunned when he heard Liu Yuniang's words.
Only then did I remember that it was not easy for me as a day laborer to earn some money. I just didn't live a good life, but when I had a little money, I still had the habit of drinking and gambling.
Li Chengfeng was speechless because he couldn't live a good life even though he was so poor. Instead, he got into bad habits. Li Chengfeng was speechless. This guy must be too useless.
But after thinking about it, I realized that the name and appearance of the body after the time-travel were exactly the same as before the time-travel. Maybe it was just myself in another world, and I suddenly felt a little embarrassed.
"Don't worry, Yu Niang, I know the severity. Hunting is not easy. Even if I have money, I won't go drinking, let alone gambling."
Li Chengfeng held Liu Yuniang's shoulders and spoke comfortingly.
There was only one bed in their house, so she slept with Liu Yuniang every night. However, Liu Yuniang used to sleep separately from him, but today, she took the initiative to come over and sleep with him.
It's a bit ambiguous for a man and a woman to sleep together on the same bed.
However, the situation was tense and he couldn't even guarantee a full meal. Li Chengfeng felt a strong sense of crisis in his heart. Coupled with the fatigue on his body, he really couldn't think of anything between men and women.
Men actually need a sense of security the most. When there is a crisis, tension, or pressure, there is no way to become capable in that area, and they cannot be in a good state.
So Li Chengfeng just held Liu Yuniang's shoulders and comforted her, without doing anything else.
——As for taking good health, eating steadily, and having a good family... Li Chengfeng will make sure Yu Niang lives a good and comfortable life.
"Okay, Chengfeng, I believe you."
When Liu Yuniang heard Li Chengfeng's words, she pursed her lips into a smile, and then she leaned softly on Li Chengfeng's shoulder and said in a gentle tone, "Then I won't do any work tomorrow. I can sell the two wild geese at home and go to the market to exchange for some grain and salt. I can't just eat meat without food."
"If you catch more prey in the future, exchange two pieces of cloth and buy two shoe soles, and I will make clothes and shoes for you."
"If we can't hunt too many prey, then we will eat by ourselves first. If we don't even have enough to eat, then I will go out to work..."
Liu Yuniang was calculating in a low voice, her face full of expectations for the future life and full of brilliance.
She was once a woman, but she had never lived such a promising life. Now she was looking forward to the future, and the look of a little woman appeared in her brows.
But after eating so much, it really made people sleepy, and she was also tired, so she fell asleep unknowingly as she talked.
Li Chengfeng felt the emotion of the woman in his arms, and felt very emotional in his heart, which was also a little heavy.
The murderous intention towards Liu Hong in my heart became even stronger.
‘Not only Liu Hong, but Master Zheng is also a problem. ’
Li Chengfeng's mind was filled with thoughts, and after Liu Yuniang fell asleep, she also closed her eyes and fell asleep silently.
"..."
